```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)
library(ggpath)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
game_id <- 401856883
# The game's kickoff date from the games table (plays carry no date).
game_date <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT startDate FROM games WHERE id = ?",
  params = list(as.integer(game_id))
)$startDate |>
  substr(1, 10) |>
  as.Date() |>
  format("%B %d, %Y")
teams <- collect(tbl(con, "teams"))
```

```{r}
#| label: drives
# One row per drive: the possession team, its outcome and its EPA; the arrows
# place each drive on the field from its first snap to where it ended.
plays <- game_plays(con, game_id)
home <- plays$home[1]
away <- plays$away[1]
team_levels <- c(home, away)
matchup <- paste0(home, " vs ", away, ", ", game_date)
season <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
  con,
  paste0(
    "SELECT gameId, driveId, driveNumber, playNumber, period, offense, ",
    "defense, home, away, offenseScore, defenseScore, yardline, yardsToGoal, ",
    "down, distance, yardsGained, playType, playText, ppa ",
    "FROM plays WHERE season = 2026"
  )
)
fit <- game_ep_fit(season)
epa <- game_epa_model(game_scrimmage(plays), fit)
drives <- game_drives(epa, plays, home, away) |>
  mutate(offense = factor(offense, team_levels))
arrows <- game_drive_arrows(drives, plays, home) |>
  mutate(offense = factor(offense, team_levels))
tallies <- drives |>
  summarise(
    drives = n(),
    touchdowns = sum(outcome == "Touchdown"),
    .by = offense
  ) |>
  arrange(offense)
tally_text <- paste0(
  tallies$offense,
  " ",
  tallies$touchdowns,
  " of ",
  tallies$drives,
  " drives ended in touchdowns",
  collapse = ", "
)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# A muted field so the team colors and outcome markers carry the eye; each
# team's logo sits in the end zone it defends.
field_green <- "#5d7a5c"
end_zone_green <- "#4b654a"
end_zones <- teams |>
  filter(team %in% c(home, away)) |>
  transmute(
    team,
    logo = logo_light,
    x = if_else(team == home, -5, 105)
  )
yard_labels <- c("G", seq(10, 50, 10), seq(40, 10, -10), "G")
arrows <- arrows |>
  mutate(
    tip = paste0(
      "<b>",
      offense,
      " drive ",
      drive_n,
      "</b><br>",
      outcome,
      ", ",
      points,
      " pts<br>",
      "Started ",
      start_ytg,
      " yards from the end zone, ",
      if_else(end_ytg == 0, "reached it", paste0("ended ", end_ytg, " away")),
      "<br>Total EPA on the drive: ",
      if_else(
        is.na(drive_epa),
        "none (no rated plays)",
        as.character(round(drive_epa, 2))
      )
    )
  )
p <- ggplot(arrows) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = 0,
    xmax = 100,
    ymin = -1,
    ymax = 61,
    fill = field_green
  ) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = c(-10, 100),
    xmax = c(0, 110),
    ymin = -1,
    ymax = 61,
    fill = end_zone_green
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = seq(5, 95, 10),
    color = "white",
    alpha = 0.35,
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = seq(0, 100, 10),
    color = "white",
    alpha = 0.8,
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = c(15, 30, 45),
    color = "black",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_from_path(
    data = end_zones,
    aes(x = x, y = 30, path = logo),
    width = 0.08
  ) +
  geom_segment_interactive(
    data = \(d) filter(d, abs(x1 - x0) >= 1),
    aes(
      x = x0,
      y = t0,
      xend = x1,
      yend = t1,
      color = offense,
      tooltip = tip,
      data_id = driveId
    ),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.14, "inches"), type = "closed"),
    linewidth = 1.6
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      x = x1,
      y = t1,
      shape = outcome,
      color = offense,
      tooltip = tip,
      data_id = paste(driveId, "end")
    ),
    size = 3.5,
    stroke = 1.2
  ) +
  scale_color_team(teams, name = "Offense") +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Touchdown" = 17,
      "Field goal" = 15,
      "No score" = 16,
      "Turnover" = 4
    ),
    name = "Drive ends",
    drop = FALSE,
    guide = guide_legend(nrow = 2)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 10),
    labels = yard_labels,
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse(
    breaks = c(7.5, 22.5, 37.5, 52.5),
    labels = paste0("Q", 1:4),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-10, 110), ylim = c(61, -1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Logos mark the end zone each team defends",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Drives on the field, by outcome",
    subtitle = paste0(matchup, "; ", tally_text),
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.justification = "left"
  )

card_thumbnail(p, "game-drive-outcomes", release = release)
card_interactive(p, width_svg = 12, height_svg = 10)
```

```{r}
#| label: table
drives |>
  count(offense, outcome, name = "n") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = outcome, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  arrange(offense) |>
  transmute(Offense = as.character(offense), across(-offense)) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Offense", "Touchdown", "Field goal", "No score", "Turnover"),
    caption = "Drives by outcome for each offense in the game."
  )
```
